decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution builds directly on the firm's core aviation security and border-compliance knowledge, has proven uptake with the UK Home Office and over 30 governmental APIS schemes, and stays prominently presented, so the firm can interpret its results and keep improving it.

The travel health requirements API sits close to the firm's passenger-data and document-checking expertise and remains on its own page, but post-pandemic demand for health rules is uncertain and no results are reported, which adds some risk of it being folded into other products or dropped.

The travel and document verification platform draws on the firm's specialist document-detection know-how and airline customer base and complements the data transmission solution, so it fits the firm's knowledge base and is likely to be retained.
